description: Dare ghosts + roster rebalance announcement · 2-tweet thread. Tweet 1 is the dare mechanic with the evergreen ?ghost=daily link (the growth loop: a dare gives the timeline something to DO). Tweet 2 is the buff-only rebalance, framed as pick-your-fighter freedom. Operator: attach bitcoin-kart-sizzle.mp4 (Desktop) to tweet 1 for the algorithm boost, post manually via X UI or fire with post-thread.ts. No em dashes.
tweets:
New in Bitcoin Kart: every run you share is now a dare.

Your post carries your actual ghost. Whoever clicks it races YOUR line on YOUR track. Beat a ghost and the dare passes to you.

The world best is on track right now: galaxymind.space/bitcoin-kart?ghost=daily

Also live: a full roster rebalance. Every racer buffed toward Saylor, nobody nerfed, and a physics sim now proves all ten drivers finish within 2.5 percent of each other.

Pick your fighter. The chair is no longer the only answer.
